questions.text: What will be ratio of money invested in  Bank and share market  after 2 year?
questions.explanation:
Given:

Investment in Bank = 7.5 lakh

Investment in Share market = 3.75 lakh

Annual compound rate of interest on bank investment = 10%

Annual compound rate of interest on Share market investment = 5%

Formula:

P = A (1 + R / 100) T

Calculation:

Investment in bank after 2 year = 7.5(1 + 10/100)2

⇒ Investment in bank after 2 years = 907500

Investment in Share market after 2 years = 3.75(1 + 5/100)2

⇒ Investment in Share market after 2 years = 413437.5

∴ Ratio of investment in bank after 2 year: investment in share market after 2 year =

907500 / 413437.5

⇒ Ratio of investment in bank after 2 year: investment in share market after 2 year = 968 : 441

questions.text: What will be the approx value of investment in the real state after 4 year?
questions.explanation:
Given:

Investment in the real estate = 3.75 lakh

Investment increase 3 year with annual rate = 5%

Decrease in fourth year = 5%

Formula used-

P = A (1 + R / 100) T

Calculation-

Investment after 3 year = 3.75 (1 + 5 / 100)3

⇒ Investment after 3 year = 3.75 (1 + 1 / 20)3

⇒ Investment after 3 year = 434110

In fourth year investment decrease 5%

⇒ investment in 4th year = 434110 (1 – 5 / 100)1

⇒ Investment in 4th year = 434110 × 19 / 20

Hence investment after 4 year = 412405

questions.text: What will be ratio of money, invested in agriculture land and bank?
questions.explanation:
Given:

Money invested in agriculture land = 15 lakh

Money invested in Bank = 7.5 Lakh

Formula used;

A : B = A / B

Calculation:

Money invested in agriculture land = 15 lakh

Money invested in Bank = 7.5 Lakh

⇒ Money Invested in agriculture: Money Invested in Bank = 15 / 7.5

Hence Money Invested in agriculture:  Money Invested in Bank = 2 : 1

questions.text: What will be Total value of investment of Ram Mohan on 1<sup style="">st</sup> June 2011?
questions.explanation:
Given:

Investment in land = 15 Lakh

Investment in bank = 7.5 lakh

Investment in share = 3.75 lakh

Investment in real-estate = 3.75 lakh

Formula used-

P = A (1+ R / 100) T

Calculation:

Value of money invested in Agriculture land = 15 × 1.1 = 16.5 lakh

Value of money invested in Bank after one year = 7.5 × 1.1 = 8.25 lakh

Value of money invested in share after one year = 3.75 × 21/20 = 3.9375 lakh

Value of money invested in Real estate after one year = 3.75 × 1.05 = 3.9375 lakh

⇒ Total value of the money after one year = 32.625 lakh

questions.text: Find the difference between the number of Science books sold by seller Q and seller R.
questions.explanation:
Common solution:

From the given question, 

Total number of books sold by seller P = 400

also, number of Science books sold by seller P = 220

Therefore, Number of Maths books sold by seller P = (400 - 220) = 180

The ratio of number of Maths and Science books sold by sellers P and Q respectively is 3 : 5.

Therefore, number of Science books sold by seller Q = (180/3) × 5 = 60 × 5 = 300

Also, total number of books sold by seller Q = 500

therefore, number of maths books sold by seller Q = (500 - 300) = 200

Total number of books sold by R is 60% of the total number of books sold by seller = 60% of 500 = 300

The ratio of number of Maths and Science books sold by seller R is 8 : 7

Total number of books sold by R = 300

Therefore, 8x + 7x = 15x = 300

Therefore, number of Maths book sold by seller R is = (300/15) × 8 = 160

Also, number of Science book sold by seller R is = (300/15) × 7 = 140

Total number of Maths books sold by all the booksellers = 800

Total number of Science books sold by all the booksellers = 1000

Therefore, number of Maths books sold by seller S = Total number of Maths books sold by all sellers - number of Maths books sold by sellers P, Q, and R.

= 800 - (180 + 200 + 160) = 800 - 540 = 260

Also, number of Science books sold by seller S = Total number of Science books sold by all sellers - number of Science books sold by sellers P, Q, and R.

= 1000 - (220 + 300 + 140) = 1000 - 660 = 340

Sellers Maths books  Science books Total books sold
P 180 220 400
Q 200 300 500
R 160 140 300
S 260 340 600
Total 800 1000 1800

From above table, 

Number of Science books sold by seller Q = 300 

Number of Science books sold by seller R = 140 

Therefore, required difference = 300 - 140 = 160

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
